did.head: Descriptive Summary
did.unittitle: Bonds of the Auditor of Public Accounts, 1777-1894

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Virginia Auditor of Public Accounts. Bonds, 1777-1894. Accession APA 259. State government records collection, The Library of Virginia, Richmond, Virginia.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Bonds, 1777-1894, between state and local employees and the governor or commonwealth of Virginia, for a variety of public positions, and submitted to the Virginia Auditor of Public Accounts. Positions include: inspectors of tobacco, sheriffs, notaries public, clerks of court, commissioners of revenue, and the Penitentiary. Also included are bonds for officers of the Virginia Manufactory of Arms, as well as the treasurer of the Virginia Normal and Collegiate Institute (now Virginia State University), and Eastern State Institution. Officeholders swore to fulfill faithfully the responsibilities of their offices, or pay a fine in the amount specified in the bond. Each bond contains the signatures of the claimant and securities, the date, and the amount of each bond.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection is arranged alphabetically by office.
